description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy component within the leave entitlement module of the OrangeHRM project. It contains various test cases that verify the behavior of leave entitlement consumption logic, particularly focusing on leave creation handling with respect to different entitlement scenarios.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy, testing various leave entitlement consumption scenarios, including no entitlements, partial entitlements, exact matches, over-allocations, and boundary conditions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy, and loads fixture data for testing.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeNoEntitlements
methods.description: Tests the behavior when no leave entitlements are available for the employee and leave type, with no entitlement allowance.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementBeforeApply
methods.description: Verifies handling when there is a single entitlement before the leave application date.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementBeforeAssign
methods.description: Verifies handling when there is a single entitlement before leave assignment, with entitlement allowance.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementAfterApply
methods.description: Tests behavior when entitlement starts after the leave has been applied.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementAfterAssign
methods.description: Checks entitlement consumption logic when leave is assigned after entitlement start.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementNotSufficientApply
methods.description: Verifies behavior when a single entitlement has insufficient remaining days to cover the leave.

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementNotSufficientAssign
methods.description: A disabled/ignored test case meant to verify handling of insufficient entitlement during assignment; currently inactive.

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementExactAmount
methods.description: A disabled/ignored test case for exactly matching entitlement amount with leave duration.

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementExtra
methods.description: A disabled/ignored test case for entitlement with extra days beyond leave duration.

methods.name: xtestGetLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: A disabled/ignored test for leave balance date limits in absence of entitlement date constraints.

methods.name: verifyEntitlements
methods.description: Helper method to verify the structure and contents of entitlement results against expected current and change states.
